All were removed before any commit. Bus state in this repository now carries mechanism and non-identifying status only. Whether the control plane belongs in a public repository at all is an open question for the principal.

subject: Lane vocabulary
summary: The April 2026 lane doctrine in Drive tags content Lane A, Lane B, Cross-Lane or Lane-Neutral. The code vocabulary in governance-core has no Cross-Lane member. The kernel expresses a crossing as a declared bridge instead. Recorded, not silently reconciled. See ADR-0001.

subject: Lane A acting capacity
summary: The controlling instruction set limits the Lane A human capacity to Minister or Authorized Representative absent a separate appointment. The April 2026 Drive doctrine also lists Trustee and Executor as typical Lane A capacities. The later instruction is the current-control source; the divergence is recorded rather than settled by an agent.

subject: Competing architecture documents
summary: Several overlapping governance-architecture documents from February 2026 sit in Drive with no supersession marking. Which one controls is UNKNOWN and needs a human decision plus a supersession pass.

subject: Automation ownership unassigned
summary: No production trigger and write path has an assigned owning automation engine. Until one is assigned, no engine may be described as owning any workflow, and duplicate-write risk stays open.
